en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a domed church building with classical architectural elements, situated on a landscaped hill beside a road. The structure has a large central dome with a lantern, arched windows, and adjoining wings; in the background are additional hospital-style buildings and a tree-covered hillside. Printed text at the top identifies the location as a church of the regional hospital in Graz.
